overviews.title: Diploma in Engineering colleges in India: Admissions, Courses, Placement, Fees
overviews.intro: There are around 5,000+ best Engineering colleges in India that provide diploma courses. Out of these, 3000+ colleges are private , 1,000+ are owned by the government and 200+ by public private organisations. Admissions to these colleges are majorly based on merit. COEP, MIT WPU, LPU, IIT Delhi, Galgotias University and Jaypee Institute of Information Technology are some of the top college options.

content.text: A Diploma in Engineering course is a technical education program that provides students with practical and theoretical knowledge in various branches of engineering. This course is generally pursued after completing Class 10 and is designed to provide students with the skills for entry-level positions in the engineering industry.
